ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: In the diagram, within $\triangle ABC$, where $AB=10$, $AC=8$, the angle bisectors of $\angle ABC$ and $\angle ACB$ intersect at point D. A line through D, $EF\parallel BC$, intersects $AB$ at point E, and intersects $AC$ at point F. What is the perimeter of $\triangle AEF$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $EF\parallel BC$\\
$\therefore \angle BDE=\angle DBC$\\
Since $BD$ bisects $\angle ABC$\\
$\therefore \angle DBC=\angle DBE$\\
$\therefore \angle BDE=\angle DBE$\\
$\therefore BE=DE$\\
Similarly, it can be proved that $CF=DF$\\
Since $AB=10$, $AC=8$\\
$\therefore$ the perimeter of $\triangle AEF = AE+AF+DE+DF=AE+AF+BE+CF=AB+AC=\boxed{18}$
